The controller assigns `host.host = params[:embeddable_host][:host]`, so a request missing that key yields a nil host, and saving raises NoMethodError (500) in the before_validation callback instead of the intended validation error from `validates_format_of`. This is a real defect introduced by the new code in this diff.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/models/embeddable_host.rb`, the `before_validation` block unconditionally calls `self.host.sub!(...)` twice. If `host` is `nil` (e.g., `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host` assigns `host.host = params[:embeddable_host][:host]` and that param is missing), `sub!` will raise `NoMethodError` before validations can run, resulting in a 500 instead of a validation error response.
